try: Read Benjamin’s updates and approve one
how:
1. Open Benjamin Han’s project and read the filled button (top right), then press "Client" (it opens on "Updates")
2. Read the chips and each post’s band
3. On "Feature wall panels have arrived" press "Approve"
expect: The filled button reads "Review the update" (the top of Needs you). Client’s title line is the chips Updates · Messages · Tickets · Meetings · Questionnaire, Updates picked; under them All · Published · In review · Sent back, posts grouped by day. "Wardrobe carcass is up…" reads "Sent back by Dane … — Add a close-up of the laminate — Benjamin asked about the finish." with Edit · Post; published posts end "Seen by Benjamin …" (not "Kitchen cabinets are in"). Approve answers "Approved — Benjamin can see “Feature wall panels have arrived”".

try: Post an update with photos, tied to a stage
how:

4. Press "Post"
